Signal mapping projects accepted raw conversion evidence without recalculating values; report serialization omits absent raw conversion fields in audit and comparison ledgers. Observed audits report local first-order threshold-sized resolution from independent checked occurrences and rederived values, without solving or changing verdicts; native scale provenance is reported separately, including explicit unknown sources.
